title: irc-botnet-channels
author: Unknown
description: Checks an IRC server for channels that are commonly used by malicious botnets. Control the list of channel names with the irc-botnet-channels.channels script argument. The default list of channels is * loic * Agobot * Slackbot * Mytob * Rbot * SdBot * poebot * IRCBot * VanBot * MPack * Storm * GTbot * Spybot * Phatbot * Wargbot * RxBot
